consignes: French metropolitan accent. Warm, close and lively documentary narrator, calm authority, around 155 words per minute on average. Slow down clearly on dates, names and numbers; lift the energy slightly on transitions; leave a short breath after a question. Quotations are read soberly, without imitating anyone. Clear full voice, natural pauses. No advertising tone, no drama, no ominous voice, no whisper, no shouting. Read exactly the transcript and nothing else.
texte_echantillon: Versailles, Nantes, Angers, Roquebrune-sur-Argens : des noms que nous allons souvent retrouver. Alors, que sait-on vraiment de Xavier Dupont de Ligonnès ? Reprenons dans l'ordre, en séparant ce qui est établi de ce qui est supposé. Ici, Les Mystères d'Akeb.
